scope: Current task-owned code/tests/scripts, outer incident documents and actual control observations outside the migration-tree recorder scope.
algorithm: SHA-256 of raw file bytes; symlinks hash raw link text and are not traversed.
selection: All current migration-family contracts, operator scripts, Foundry recovery scripts and migration spec/fork tests.
Every dirty source/support path in read-only Git discovery, without dropping deleted paths.
Every dirty outer-document path outside the migration recorder root.
All original and renewed dtf-conformance claims/verdicts and current plan/draft/control identity files.
Environment roots are disclosed separately rather than recursively attributed as authored source.
